# Important: domain name change affecting all endpoints

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Sandra** (2/18/2025):

Apigee (our API management platform) is undergoing a technical upgrade, and as part of the upgrade, we are updating our endpoints to use BC Government DNS names to improve trust in the services.

The DNS for the endpoints will change from ***.apigee.net** to ***.api.connect.gov.bc.ca**.

The new and old DNS names will run in parallel for a few months, but we will be retiring the *.apigee.io DNS names as of April 30, 2025.

All API users must update their applications to use the new **api.connect.gov.bc.ca** namespace **before April 30, 2025.**
